# Vonssy — Web3 Builder & Automation Engineer

> Vonssy is the builder identity of Reyvaldi Zakaria, a Web3 builder and automation engineer based in Indonesia (UTC+7). He builds automation systems, bots, and backend software that interact with real APIs, wallets, blockchains, and data.

## What the site is
A personal portfolio presenting selected automation, Web3, and backend engineering work. It is a single-page site with the sections listed below.

## Sections
- [About](#about): Background from programming fundamentals (C/C++, JavaScript, PHP, SQL, Python, AI/ML, mobile) into software that runs against the real world — wallets, blockchains, APIs, accounts, proxies, and data.
- [Projects](#projects): Selected repositories from two public GitHub accounts, filterable by Web3, Automation, Bots, Blockchain, Scraping, Web, AI/ML, and Tools.
- [Stack](#stack): The working stack grouped by function — Python automation, backend engineering, web scraping, blockchain/Web3 tooling, APIs, and AI/ML.
- [GitHub](#github): Live GitHub stats and links to the two accounts.
- [FAQ](#faq): Direct answers about who Vonssy is, what he builds, his stack, where to find his code, and how to contact him.
- [Contact](#contact): Ways to start a collaboration.
